raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 26 duplicate rows are amount corrections (record_version=2) that repeat an existing txn_id, as described in the 2026-01-18 payments-source change note. The silver step keeps every version, so the same txn_id is counted twice in silver and in the gold aggregates. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id, then applying the POSTED filter, gives the current state of each transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
